ema_lon_vix.label: London EMA trend pullback
ema_lon_vix.summary: London hours (03:00-09:30 ET, no Mondays): 15m and 1h EMA 21 above the 50, a pullback to the 5m EMA 50 sweeps a swing low, a 5m CISD back up; stop beyond the sweep wick, VIX-band target, breakeven + costs at 1R.

macd_sweep.label: MACD divergence at a liquidity sweep
macd_sweep.summary: London (02:00-05:00 ET) and NY open (09:30-11:00): a LIT level is swept by 0.5 ATR, a 5m CISD closes back with MACD-line divergence; market entry, stop beyond the sweep extreme, VIX-band target, 15-minute check.

sr_nyreclaim.name: nyreclaim
sr_nyreclaim.label: NY sweep-and-reclaim of the day's levels (S/R)
sr_nyreclaim.summary: NY 09:30-12:00 ET: a level of the day (yesterday's RTH high/low, overnight, Asia / London box, last week, opening range) is swept after an inducement, a strong 5m close reclaims it; market entry, stop beyond the sweep extreme, 2R target, 15-minute check, 1 a day.

lit_asia.with_lit_label: this is LIT plus the Asia trade (shadow of the live LIT)

sh_asia.label: Asia resweep hunt
sh_asia.summary: Asia 18:00-02:00 ET: a 15m / 1h / session / day / week high or low is run by 0.5 ATR, a resweep follows, then a 5m candle >= 1.2 ATR closes back through the pool and the last swing; market entry, stop 1 tick beyond the hunt extreme, 2R, BE + 1.25 at 1R, flat 15:55, 1 a session.
sh_asia.with_lit_note: Candidate ATLAS member for the 25K (research: ATLAS + it 2-week pass H1 79.8% / H2 56.5%, 0 fails). Next to LIT on the 50K it adds eval fails: not for LIT's account.
rules: Pools (where retail stops sit, each known before it is used): higher-timeframe pools (15m/1h swings, 15m equal, sessions, day, week).
Hunt: a 5m bar trades 1+ tick through the pool and the hunt reaches >= 0.5 ATR beyond it.
Then: a RESWEEP first: the same pool re-run after a close back inside, or the hunt's new extreme taken after a 0.5 ATR bounce.

Trigger within 36 5m bars of the hunt: a strong candle back toward the draw, a body >= 1.2 x ATR(14, 5m), closing back beyond the pool and beyond the last confirmed 5m swing the other way (market structure shift).
Entry: market at the next 5m open + 1 tick. Hours: Asia 18:00-02:00 ET; max 1 trade(s) a session, one position at a time.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the hunt extreme (the protected low/high); stop 6-80 pts, else no trade; size follows the stop.
Target: fixed 2R; no target that far = no trade.
Management: stop to entry + 1.25 pts at +1R (LIT's BE + costs); flat 15:55 ET (MFFU: flat by 16:10).
Costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries and stop / time / flat exits. Scored at $500 risk a trade.

sh_trend.label: Trend inducement hunt
sh_trend.summary: Any hour 18:00-15:30 ET: a pullback against the 1h trend takes an inducement swing and runs a 5m swing by 0.25 ATR, then a 5m candle >= 1.2 ATR back with the trend closes through the pool and the last swing; limit at mid-candle for 30 min, stop 1 tick beyond the hunt extreme, 2R, BE + 1.25 at 1R, flat 15:55, 2 a session.
sh_trend.with_lit_note: Candidate ATLAS member for the 25K (research: ATLAS + both hunts 2-week pass H1 74.8% / H2 65.2%, 0 fails). Its wider family does not beat chance: paper first.
rules: Pools (where retail stops sit, each known before it is used): 5m swing highs/lows.
Hunt: a 5m bar trades 1+ tick through the pool and the hunt reaches >= 0.25 ATR beyond it.
Then: an INDUCEMENT before the hunt (LIT style): a 5m swing within 1 ATR of the pool was taken on the way in.

Trigger within 6 5m bars of the hunt: a strong candle back toward the draw, a body >= 1.2 x ATR(14, 5m), closing back beyond the pool and beyond the last confirmed 5m swing the other way (market structure shift).

Entry: a limit at the middle of the trigger candle for 30 minutes. Hours: any hour 18:00-15:30 ET; max 2 trade(s) a session, one position at a time. Only in the direction of the 1h trend (last closed 1h close vs its EMA 50): the hunt is a pullback against the trend.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the hunt extreme (the protected low/high); stop 6-80 pts, else no trade; size follows the stop.
Target: fixed 2R; no target that far = no trade.
Management: stop to entry + 1.25 pts at +1R (LIT's BE + costs); flat 15:55 ET (MFFU: flat by 16:10).
Costs: $1.90 a micro round trip + 1 tick slippage on market entries and stop / time / flat exits. Scored at $500 risk a trade.
